title: Old Town - 6BD/5BA + Heated Pool + BBQ + Hot Tub
description:
Spacious 6-bed / 5-bath Old Town escape!

Heated pool & hot tub, Bbq, game room with billiards, ping-pong, foosball & board games, fire-pit patio, coffee bar and full kitchens make group stays effortless.

6 bedrooms / 5 baths / sleeps 14
Fast Wi-Fi & smart TVs
Washer & dryer
Free driveway parking 
Licensed & professionally cleaned. 
Questions? We reply in under an hour—book your dates now!

 The space 
Enjoy exclusive access to the entire home during your stay. Nestled in a tranquil residential neighborhood, this vacation rental is perfect for a relaxing poolside getaway.

The house comfortably hosts up to 14 guests with 6 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms. Outfitted with modern conveniences, including a heated pool and hot tub, (pool heating available for an additional $100 a night fee), it’s an excellent choice for those wanting to be close to all of Scottsdale’s attractions.

This split-level property boasts a well-designed layout. The lower level includes three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, while the upper level offers three additional bedrooms and two more full bathrooms. The main floor, the heart of the home, features an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area that effortlessly connects to a backyard with a pool.

☀️FAQs

☀️EARLY CHECK IN OPTION
We are at the mercy of the calendar! The only way to guarantee early check-in is by booking the night before. If you want to take a gamble, you can wait until 24hrs before check-in to see if our schedule allows it. If a guest is checking out the day of your arrival or if we have scheduled maintenance, early check-in isn't possible.

☀️Late Check Out?
Just as we did for your arrival, we must prepare again for the next guest. If your flight leaves late in the day, please consider booking an additional night so you can leave at your leisure.

☀️OUTSIDE VENDORS
Outside vendors must be approved by hosts.

☀️Parking
NO more than 4 cars allowed per booking, 2 cars in the driveway and 2 in front of the home.
**NO PARKING IN FRONT OF NEIGHBORING HOMES.

☀️PETS?
No pets allowed. 

☀️YES, WE ARE LICENSED
City of Scottsdale Vacation Rental License: 2040420
TPT: 21618678

☀️To preserve the community’s tranquility, please be considerate of neighbors during your vacation.
To ensure our homes maintain high standards and neighborhoods remain peaceful, all guests must follow city and house rules. 

☀️Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM, and guests should be mindful of neighbors. The city prohibits loud music, excessive noise, events, and blocking neighbors’ driveways with street parking. Fines for violations will be the responsibility of guests. Overnight guests must not exceed the property’s posted occupancy limit.

☀️Parties and events are not authorized at this listing. Any noise violations, neighbor complaints, or situation where law enforcement is called may result in fines up to $2500.

☀️Accidents happen, if you find that an accident has occurred, we would appreciate if you could let us know before you checkout.

☀️ The property includes three (3) propane tanks that will be filled before your arrival.

☀️Pool is professionally serviced weekly. Service day and times subject to change. Access to the property by these service personnel is not to be impeded by guest. Please contact the Host if you would like to confirm the service timing or have any concerns.

 Guest access 
Guests have private access to the entire home and outdoor areas including the pool, spa as well as free Wi-Fi, free parking, complimentary coffee, and access to a washing machine and dryer.

Guests will self check-in using the code provided for the front door.

 Other things to note 
*The pool does not have a fence, so take that into consideration if you have children in tow.
*By booking this property, you agreed to the following :
**GUEST SWIM AT THEIR OWN RISK.
**WAIVER OF LIABILITY: you understand that you using the swimming pool at your own risk and that special risk may be involved in using the swimming pool. You accept full responsibility for any bodily injury arising from views of the swimming pool and hold the owner harmless. You understand that children must be supervised at all times around the pool. There are potential dangers that the swimming pool may present to children who are not carefully supervised. 
**It is not advised to use the swimming pool while intoxicated or using any kind of drugs or medication or uses the swimming pool if pregnant. 
*You understand the risks discussed above and agree that you will assume all responsibility for yourself and your guests for the consequences of those risks. You agree to waive any claim whatsoever against owner for accidents or claims arising from your guests' use of swimming pool.

House Rules:
*No smoking indoors
*No pets allowed - Undisclosed pets are subject to fines of up to $1,000 with additional charges applicable for damage or deep cleaning
*No events, parties, or large gatherings without prior notice.

NOTE: Your safety matters. An exterior security doorbell camera is located at the front door, facing out towards the entrance. One camera overlooking the front of the house and two on each side. The cameras don’t look into any interior spaces or backyard.
